info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card E-Commerce Gateway API
info.description: The Card E-Commerce Gateway API enables secure processing of electronic card transactions within e-commerce platforms. It allows businesses to facilitate payment gateway interactions, ensuring efficient authorizations and settlements. This API primarily serves online retailers and payment solution providers, offering a seamless integration to manage card payments. Key operations include transaction inquiries and status checks, empowering developers to deliver enhanced payment functionalities to their applications.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a card payment for e-commerce.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the payment status associated with a specific card transaction identified by the payment ID. It provides details on the transaction state and any related information necessary for order processing.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters for retrieving information via the card e-commerce gateway. It should be formatted as JSON and adhere to the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the response includes the requested data.

GetCardEcommercePaymentStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to the card payments in the e-commerce gateway. The expected input format is a string.

debtorAccountId.description: Identifier for the account from which the amount is debited.

creditorAccountId.description: Identifier for the account to which the amount is credited.

instructedAmount.description: The amount that has been instructed for the transaction.

requestedExecutionDate.description: The date on which the payment is requested to be executed.

remittanceInformation.description: Additional information related to the remittance.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the payment record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the payment record was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the payment.

GetCardEcommercePaymentStatusResponse_20.description: Represents the response for a card payment operation in an e-commerce gateway.

amount.description: The numerical value of the amount.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is specified.

InstructedAmount.description: Represents the amount instructed for the payment transaction.

correlationId.description: Identifier for tracking the related requests or transactions.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the processing of the payment took place.

Metadata.description: Contains metadata related to the payment transaction.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint, used to track request routing.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that processed the request, allowing identification of the source application.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication method that uses a bearer token, which should be a JSON Web Token (JWT), to authorize and authenticate requests.
